overview_description.description:
HUD is the platform for building high quality post training datasets. Over 50 businesses use HUD to build RL environments, sell them to AI labs, or train their own models from them.

Their mission is to enable a generation of data entrepreneurs. The previous generation built apps to impact the world. We believe people will build infrastructure around data, both digital and physical, that align AIs to their specific goals.
